name: Philips 55OLED708
summary: Philips 55OLED708 ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker, promos and demo apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and undo.
intro: This Philips OLED runs Google TV and ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker, TP Vision telemetry, Philips and Google promos, a retail demo and first-setup leftovers. The list also covers Philips features this owner does not use and preinstalled apps in the user app area.

It was applied in small batches, with a screenshot and a 30 second idle-log check after each. No retry loop appeared. Home, HDMI 2 with a PS5, Live TV, Settings and YouTube kept working. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: HDMI, component and composite inputs (the MediaTek TV input service)
notes: Forget and re-join your Wi-Fi first. The setup wizard may own the saved network and Android deletes it when the wizard is switched off.
Casting this owner does not use is off, but AirPlay is kept.

faq.q: Does the Samba TV tracker get turned off?
faq.a: Yes. The Samba TV viewing tracker, which comes preinstalled, is on the list.
Yes. Google Assistant is kept on purpose, and so are AirPlay and firmware updates.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
